idea-plugin.name: Copy Selection Reference
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin copies a file reference with line numbers to the clipboard for selected text.
Features: - Copies file path with line numbers (e.g., "src/main/MyFile.java:4-10") - Works with any file type - Uses relative paths from project root - Simple and lightweight
idea-plugin.change-notes: Version 1.0.0: - Initial release - Copy file reference with line numbers to clipboard

action.description: Copies file reference with line numbers to clipboard
